name: Entitlement Quality Monitor
tagline: Stop overpaying for software your people don't use.
description: Connects to your identity provider, flags entitlement drift in real time, and surfaces remediation actions. Built on FastAPI and Appian. Production-tested for SaaS license recovery.

name: Resiliency Testing Orchestrator
tagline: Run a BCP test without calling a meeting.
description: OOR-first business continuity simulator. Define your recovery scope, run a scenario, and get a structured gap report — no consultant required. FastAPI backend with Streamlit UI.

name: Human Workforce Analytics
tagline: Your content strategy, driven by actual channel data.
description: Auto-refreshing YouTube analytics dashboard that pulls live metrics every 4 hours via GitHub Actions. Tracks views, watch time, subscriber growth, and top content — no manual exports.

name: CMDB Risk Dashboard
tagline: Know which data center outage will actually hurt before it happens.
description: Live risk assessment reporting dashboard for data center CMDB assets. Scores infrastructure by exposure, criticality, and control gaps, then ranks assets so risk and ops teams can prioritize remediation instead of reacting to the next outage. Reads live from a deployed FastAPI backend.

name: Service Risk & Availability Dashboard
tagline: See every service a third party touches — and every gap in it.
description: Bottom-up view of the services a third party provides across data center clients, mapped to the gaps in each one. Surfaces and ranks remediation priorities so risk teams can act on the weakest links first instead of reviewing services in isolation.

name: Knowledge Evolution Layer
tagline: Track what your organization knows — before the gap becomes a liability.
description: Embeddings-based drift detection that surfaces how institutional knowledge diverges from team behavior over time. Routes queries across local and cloud LLMs based on sensitivity.

name: Layman's Spending Assessment
tagline: Plain-English answers to 'where is my money going?'
description: Local Streamlit app that ingests RocketMoney CSV exports and provides an AI-powered spending dashboard with Claude chat. Distributed as a zip — no cloud dependency, no data leaves your machine.

name: PBL Evaluator
tagline: Score the plain business language behind every entitlement.
description: Lets managers evaluate the quality of an entitlement's plain business language and RBAC design before it ships, catching vague remediation steps and inconsistent access rules before they become audit findings.

name: FlightWatch Virtual Travel Agent
tagline: See the route combination worth watching—not just another fare list.
description: Guided product simulator showing how FlightWatch turns a flexible Europe brief into cabin-aware, open-jaw flight recommendations and an actionable fare email. Uses fixed fictional sample data, makes no live API calls, and collects no personal data.

name: Job Search Dashboard
tagline: Turn job-application emails into a clear status view.
description: Interactive demonstration of a local-first job search tracker. Explore 50 recent application records by company, role, date, and status. The retail product guides job seekers through building their own private local dashboard with Codex or Claude.
